body: A copied verse about helping a wounded stranger is folded around an unpaid bar tab; the return slip marks the road pass as revoked.
title: A verse on the return

cites.quote: How quaint and curious war is

gloss: A revoked road pass sits with a personal reminder about helping someone.
rival_reading: The pass could have been withdrawn for ordinary work or security reasons; the poem and tab do not prove a failed response.
